entry.title: New: Resolution 639 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO THE FRIENDS OF THE FUTURE FOR EXPENSES RELATING TO THE FRIENDLY FRIDGE RESCUE FOOD PROGRAM

Transfers $4,350 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 9)
